description:
Get the raw content of a Spark asset (prompt text, skill instructions, agent config) —
the actual text to apply, not just a description of it.

For when a known asset's content is needed for application; get_asset provides
details without acquisition. Each successful fetch records a download/acquisition;
repeated calls create new receipts and content may change after updates.
Free content needs no login. Paid content requires a Spark API key (X-API-Key)
or Bearer token and prior purchase or ownership; this tool makes no purchase.
Returns content and an application_id for report_outcome, or a not-found/access
message. Content may be a source link rather than embedded text.

For example, get_asset_content(slug='vb-seo-expert').

slug.description: Exact asset slug from a search result or Spark URL, e.g. 'vb-seo-expert'; not a URL or asset ID.

name: get_asset_content
title: Get asset content
